question: Which Indian city is home to the Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology (MNNIT), where research on lightning impact on planes is being conducted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prayagraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology (MNNIT)** is located in **Prayagraj**, Uttar Pradesh. It is one of the premier engineering institutions in India and is renowned for its research and academic excellence.
 
• MNNIT is conducting research on the **impact of lightning strikes on aircraft**, which is a critical area of study for aviation safety. This research aims to improve the design and resilience of aircraft against lightning-related damages.
 
• The institute specializes in various fields of engineering and technology, including **aerospace engineering**, making it an ideal location for such research.
 
• **Prayagraj** is a prominent city in Uttar Pradesh, known for its historical significance, educational institutions, and as a hub for advanced research.
 
• This research at MNNIT aligns with India's efforts to enhance technological advancements and ensure safer aviation practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology (MNNIT):**

 
 
• MNNIT was established in **1961** as a Regional Engineering College and was later upgraded to a National Institute of Technology in **2002**.
 
• The institute is recognized for its contributions to research, particularly in **aerospace, electrical, and mechanical engineering**.
 
• It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various engineering disciplines.
 
• MNNIT has collaborations with international institutions and industries to conduct cutting-edge research and provide solutions to real-world problems.
 
 
 
• **Lightning Impact on Aircraft:**
 
 
• Lightning strikes on aircraft can cause severe damage, including **structural damage, electronic system failure, and interference with navigation**.
 
• Research in this area focuses on developing **lightning-resistant materials** and systems to minimize risks during flights.
 
• India's aviation sector is expanding rapidly, making this research crucial for ensuring passenger and aircraft safety.
 
 
 
• **Prayagraj:**
 
 
• Prayagraj, formerly known as Allahabad, is one of the oldest cities in India, with great historical and cultural importance.
 
• It is home to several prestigious educational institutions, including **MNNIT, Allahabad University, and Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT)**.
 
• The city is known for hosting the **Kumbh Mela**, one of the largest religious gatherings in the world.
 
• Its strategic location and well-established infrastructure make it a favorable place for academic and research activities.
 
 
 
• **Aviation Safety in India:**
 
 
• The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) regulates aviation safety in India, ensuring compliance with international standards.
 
• Research institutions, including MNNIT, contribute to the development of advanced technologies to improve safety measures in the aviation industry.
 
• Lightning impact studies are part of broader efforts to enhance aircraft design and operational safety.
